name: Organized-Survival-Alpha-2.05.6
author: Toprogress
description:
Thank you for playing Organized Survival!
Rotate your device to landscape for an optimal experience.

Organized Survival is a turned-based hardcore survival game.
Incarnates up to five survivors with unique specializations and survive as many days as possible against the ever-growing number of Aliens attacking each night.
Explore the desert of Ashes to find resources and upgrade the defense of your Camp.
When your incarnations die, your Soul remains and you can incarnate new characters right away.

Join the official Discord server of Organized Survival!
https://discord.gg/UcZ8M8zD

Support me and stay tuned about all future updates by following my Patreon for free!
https://www.patreon.com/OrganizedSurvival

Attention! Refreshing or closing this web page will reset your progression.

If you are using an iPhone or and iPad you unfortunately cannot play Organized Survival because your browser will refresh automatically after the picking phase.
I am working on a fix.
However Organized Survival works perfectly on all other devices.

The music are from the game Age of Mythology. I own no rights on them and I am ready to remove them at any time.
